name: Brynom
description: Brynom was a terrestrial planet located in the galaxy. During the Clone Wars, Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker and his Padawan Ahsoka Tano followed a distress call from Brynom and were temporarily captured by a squad of Separatist B1-series battle droids.
